name: WxArticleSaver
scope: WeChat article pages opened by the user; export occurs only after manual trigger
certificate: generated locally; trusted only on the current device for local HTTPS proxying
certificate_files: kept locally under the WxArticleSaver data directory for reuse; ignored by git
routing: PAC: selected WeChat article/media hosts -> local proxy; all other hosts DIRECT
cached_page_fallback: best-effort refresh on Windows; manual refresh on macOS when needed
